verdict: 126 leads at $11.49 each — solid baseline, pipeline follow-through needs attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta campaigns delivered 126 leads at an average cost per lead of $11.49, with $1,447 in total ad spend. The most recent 7 days show a modest softening — leads down 11% and cost per lead up to roughly $12.06 — consistent with the top campaign running long enough that the audience is seeing it repeatedly. The more significant finding is in the pipeline: 126 leads entered the system, 94 moved to opportunities, and none have closed or converted to appointments, which points to a follow-up or intake gap rather than an ads problem. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to address audience fatigue, and the intake workflow is being reviewed to ensure leads are being contacted and booked promptly. Local search engagement also dipped this period; steps are underway to stabilize that visibility ahead of next month's review.
